metric.name: macro_NDCG@10
metric.gain: linear raw human rating from 1 to 10
metric.tie_policy: expected DCG under uniform within-tie permutation
metric.full_score: Every query achieves ideal DCG@10, with no tie across unequal ratings at a positive discount and all runtime/integrity gates pass.

activation_blockers: selected image payload import and content hashes
real local JEV serving/token broker and isolation integration
serving dependency lock and H100 envelope validation

data_access.prohibited: Candidate code, direct predictions, answer lookup fields, evaluator modification
data_access.claim: Benchmark-conditioned model-mediated ranking on a fully disclosed fixed workload; no unseen-item or heldout-user generalization claim

candidate_artifact.final_score: unaltered probability returned by the single native JEV S1 request

image_duplicate_policy: Report all identical-byte groups, retain all selected records without exclusions; public benchmark optimization permits cross-partition exposure.
